findings.title: Capture proofMilliseconds once before validation and persistence
findings.description: The helper reads observed.proofMilliseconds three times. An accessor can return17 for validation and a string for the copied value, causing a private sentinel/non-numeric value to be persisted in the allegedly sanitized standalone evidence while passed remains true. Exact pure reproduction confirmed reads3, persistedNonNumerictrue, sentinelPersistedtrue. The real official helper currently returns ordinary data; this is a newly introduced evidence-boundary defect, not a claim that genuine funding leaked data.
findings.repair: Capture own-data descriptor value once (preferred), or one guarded read, and validate/copy that same primitive. Accessor/throwing/invalid optional value must be omitted safely without losing the valid canonical receipt or replay fence.
findings.regression: Changing getter, throwing getter, noninteger/negative/unsafe timing; secret sentinel must never occur in persisted snapshots and no claim retry.
